llm.guidance: This skill appears coherent for booking weekend apartment cleanings in San Francisco and does not request unrelated credentials or install software. Important things to consider before enabling: 1) The skill sends personal data (name, email, full street address) to an external MCP server at https://claw.cleaning/mcp — only enable if you trust that domain and vendor. 2) Pay-now flows save cards tied to email addresses per the skill; verify you are comfortable with saved-card/auto-charge behavior and the vendor's payment/storage practices. 3) The skill relies on an unauthenticated MCP endpoint (no auth headers) — make sure your client and organization accept adding custom MCP connectors to external services. 4) The skill includes safeguards (must show full preview and obtain explicit confirmation before initiating bookings); ensure your agent enforces those rules if you allow autonomous invocation. 5) If you need higher assurance, ask the publisher for a homepage, privacy policy, or company contact and test the flow with a non-production email (or a small test booking) first.
